item.title: Murmur 1.7.4
item.description:
What's new on the Mac

Murmur sets your microphone level. A microphone turned down too far made every word arrive faint, so dictation misheard you unless you spoke up. Murmur now raises a level that's too low when you start dictating, and adjusts it a step after each dictation until your voice comes through clearly. You can turn this off in Settings under Set the microphone level.
